projects.title: DACO Airfield Management Application
projects.description:
• Worked in a team of 5 teammates to build an Android mobile app that allows the U.S. Fort Benning Army Base in Columbus, GA to perform appropriate operations on the airfield. The app facilitated quick identification of which Aircraft/Personnel/Bundle to load first onto the aircrafts based on factors such as distance, weight, and priority.
• Applied Data Structures and Algorithms to make an efficient and highly performant Android app.
• Designed UI features with Figma, implemented with Android Studio (coded in Java), and Firebase to display and retrieve data in real-time.

projects.title: The Great Maze Video Game
projects.description:
- Worked in a team of 5 teammates to build a 3D feel game, wherein a character, a chef hamster named Chef Hamm, is controlled, and guided through the eponymous Great Maize to fight and reach the end of the dungeon in a cooking themed combat competition.
- Was in charge of implementing AI interactions and path planning between game obstacles.
- Used Unity Gaming Services and coded in C#.
